page.overview:
Who is Kattigan Vale?

is a human ranger played by Robbie Daymond in Campaign Four.

Kattigan is in his mid-40's, standing at 6'4" and 220 pounds. He appears to have led a "weathered" life, and although his abilities are beginning to wane with age, he remains muscular and powerful. When first encountered, he wore scavenged but well-cared-for accoutrements of good quality, all of which were purposeful, including a cowl and hood. He also wears a leather bandolier across his chest, filled with different tinctures and herbs. Kattigan smells like clean but wet dog, with just a little bit of man sweat. Campaign 4 Ep 1-4 Recap]" | vod=https://youtu.be/hdLPwuKMlIY | 10:41}}

Kattigan has facial tattoos that mirror the scars across his wolf companion Wulferic's face. Episode 1 Discussing Up To C4E11|1:28:31}} He lost his right little finger for some hours, and after Thaisha Lloy reattached it to his hand, it left a wood-like mark as a scar.

Kattigan is a man of the wilds, uncomfortable in cities. He is unnerving to be around because of his unpredictable nature, but his wolf companion Wulferic can have a calming effect on him. Teor described him as "a fierce warrior and a good man."
